# Event 012 private Strength measurements and selected input blends.
# COUNTRY object identity is independent of native ROOT. No scheduler is installed.
# All calls use = yes. Only apply_strength_input_factors consumes caller-owned temps.
# See the matching .md for census, cache freshness, cleanup and transfer contracts.

gods_of_africa_initialize_strength_census = {
	if = {
		limit = { gods_of_africa_strength_host_is_current = yes }
		gods_of_africa_clear_strength_input_sample = yes
		clear_array = gods_of_africa_strength_countries
		clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_census_complete
		clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_world_coverage_incomplete
		set_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_census_initialized
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_census_host_id = THIS.id }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_census_generation = africa_host_generation }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_census_origin_host_id = africa_origin_host_id }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_census_size = global.countries^num }
	}
}

# COUNTRY object including dormant/reserved objects. Call before participant filters.
gods_of_africa_remember_strength_country = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = africa_host
			event_target:africa_host = {
				gods_of_africa_strength_census_owner_is_current = yes
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = gods_of_africa_strength_countries value = PREV } }
			}
		}
		event_target:africa_host = {
			add_to_array = { array = gods_of_africa_strength_countries value = PREV }
			clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_valid
			clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_input_factors_valid
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_census_complete }
				gods_of_africa_finish_strength_census = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

gods_of_africa_finish_strength_census = {
	clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_census_complete
	if = {
		limit = {
			gods_of_africa_strength_census_owner_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = gods_of_africa_strength_countries^num value = global.countries^num compare = equals }
			is_in_array = { array = gods_of_africa_strength_countries value = THIS }
		}
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_census_size = global.countries^num }
		set_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_census_complete
		clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_world_coverage_incomplete
	}
	else = { set_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_world_coverage_incomplete }
}

# HOST scope. Exactly one current observation per retained object, no host addition.
gods_of_africa_measure_strength_armies = {
	clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_valid
	clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_input_factors_valid
	clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_army_read_invalid
	if = {
		limit = { gods_of_africa_strength_census_is_complete = yes }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_k = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_army_processed_count = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_row_army_k = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_measure_strength_armies_break_1 = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			break = gods_of_africa_measure_strength_armies_break_1
			array = gods_of_africa_strength_countries
			event_target:africa_host = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_army_processed_count = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { exists = yes is_government_in_exile = yes } }
				set_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_row_army_k = deployed_army_manpower_k }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_row_army_k < constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero } }
					event_target:africa_host = { set_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_army_read_invalid }
				}
				else = {
					event_target:africa_host = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_k = gods_of_africa_strength_row_army_k } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_host_army_k_sample = deployed_army_manpower_k }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_day = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_due_day = constant:gods_of_africa_timing.owner_tick_days }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_host_id = THIS.id }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_generation = africa_host_generation }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_origin_host_id = africa_origin_host_id }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_army_read_invalid }
				check_variable = { var = gods_of_africa_strength_army_processed_count value = gods_of_africa_strength_countries^num compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = gods_of_africa_strength_host_army_k_sample value = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_k value = gods_of_africa_strength_host_army_k_sample compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_valid
			clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_world_coverage_incomplete
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_world_coverage_incomplete }
	}
	else = { set_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_world_coverage_incomplete }
}

gods_of_africa_measure_territorial_control = {
	if = {
		limit = { gods_of_africa_strength_host_is_current = yes }
		clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_input_factors_valid
		clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_territory_sample_valid
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_state_total = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_owned_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_controlled_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_secured_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_core_total = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_secured_cores = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_member_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_member_core_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_occupied_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_territorial_control = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_physical_control = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		every_collection_element = {
			input = collection:states_in_africa
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_state_total = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = PREV }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_owned_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_controlled_by = PREV }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_controlled_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_owned_by = PREV is_controlled_by = PREV }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_secured_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_core_of = PREV }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_core_total = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
				if = {
					limit = { is_owned_by = PREV is_controlled_by = PREV }
					PREV = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_secured_cores = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_owned_and_controlled_by = OWNER
					OWNER = { gods_of_africa_strength_member_is_eligible = yes }
				}
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_member_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
				if = {
					limit = { is_core_of = PREV }
					PREV = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_member_core_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_core_of = PREV
						is_owned_by = PREV
						OWNER = { gods_of_africa_strength_member_is_eligible = yes }
					}
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							is_controlled_by = PREV
							CONTROLLER = { gods_of_africa_strength_member_is_eligible = yes }
						}
					}
				}
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_occupied_states = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_african_state_total > constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero } }
			set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_territorial_control = gods_of_africa_strength_african_secured_cores }
			divide_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_territorial_control = gods_of_africa_strength_african_state_total }
			multiply_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_territorial_control = constant:gods_of_africa_strength.component_max }
			set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_physical_control = gods_of_africa_strength_african_secured_cores }
			add_to_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_physical_control = gods_of_africa_strength_member_core_states }
			divide_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_physical_control = gods_of_africa_strength_african_state_total }
			multiply_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_physical_control = constant:gods_of_africa_strength.component_max }
			set_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_territory_sample_valid
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = gods_of_africa_strength_territorial_control min = constant:gods_of_africa_strength.component_min max = constant:gods_of_africa_strength.component_max }
		clamp_variable = { var = gods_of_africa_strength_physical_control min = constant:gods_of_africa_strength.component_min max = constant:gods_of_africa_strength.component_max }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_territory_observation_day = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_territory_host_id = THIS.id }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_territory_generation = africa_host_generation }
		set_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_territory_origin_host_id = africa_origin_host_id }
	}
}

# HOST scope. Caller owns and initializes the two production component temps.
# Invalid evidence leaves those temps untouched and clears the explicit result flag.
gods_of_africa_apply_strength_input_factors = {
	clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_input_factors_valid
	if = {
		limit = {
			gods_of_africa_strength_input_sample_is_current = yes
			has_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_military
			has_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_continent
			check_variable = { var = deployed_army_manpower_k value = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_now_k = gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_k }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_now_k = gods_of_africa_strength_host_army_k_sample }
		add_to_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_now_k = deployed_army_manpower_k }
		set_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_share = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_now_k > constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_share = deployed_army_manpower_k }
			divide_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_share = gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_now_k }
		}
		divide_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_share = constant:gods_of_africa_strength_inputs.world_share_anchor }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = gods_of_africa_strength_world_share min = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero max = constant:gods_of_africa_value.one }
		multiply_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_share = constant:gods_of_africa_strength_inputs.military_relative_share }
		add_to_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_world_share = constant:gods_of_africa_strength_inputs.military_absolute_share }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = deployed_army_manpower_k value = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero compare = equals }
					check_variable = { var = num_divisions value = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero compare = less_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_military = constant:gods_of_africa_value.zero }
		}
		else = { multiply_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_military = gods_of_africa_strength_world_share } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_continent = constant:gods_of_africa_strength_inputs.continent_political_share }
		set_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_physical_component = gods_of_africa_strength_physical_control }
		multiply_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_physical_component = constant:gods_of_africa_strength_inputs.continent_physical_share }
		add_to_temp_variable = { gods_of_africa_strength_continent = gods_of_africa_strength_physical_component }
		set_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_input_factors_valid
	}
}

# HOST object, including revoked/departing owners. Discovery identity/roster survives.
gods_of_africa_clear_strength_input_sample = {
	clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_valid
	clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_army_read_invalid
	clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_territory_sample_valid
	clr_country_flag = gods_of_africa_strength_input_factors_valid
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_world_army_k
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_host_army_k_sample
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_army_processed_count
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_day
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_due_day
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_host_id
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_generation
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_army_sample_origin_host_id
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_african_state_total
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_african_owned_states
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_african_controlled_states
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_african_secured_states
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_african_core_total
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_african_secured_cores
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_member_states
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_member_core_states
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_occupied_states
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_territorial_control
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_physical_control
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_territory_observation_day
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_territory_host_id
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_territory_generation
	clear_variable = gods_of_africa_strength_territory_origin_host_id
}
